evidence: Traced shapeOf for pages that start with ---\n and have a closing line, for pages that start with ---\n and have no closing line, and for pages with a BOM, CRLF or leading blank lines. Readable pages return the bytes up to the end of the closing line, and the unreadable cases are scanned up to the first closing --- only.
Traced the no-project note in reportMigration. It is printed once on the error path and once after the counts on the success path, so no run prints it twice.
Plain pages that do not open with --- return shapeNone and are never scanned, which matches the claim and the new tests. I found no defect this change causes.
